title: How To Make AAA Quality Graphics With AI | AI Gaming Conference
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
The AI Gaming Conference is finally up and we have 21 sessions. Two are the sessions are on graphic with AI:

* [Intro To Getting Started Making Graphics With AI (September 16th)](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/01a0542f-17f4-726d-a334-91ddc8d4bf4c/standalone)
* [How To Make AAA Quality Graphics For Your Game (September 18th)](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/01a069f7-da40-70d6-9952-b2660f0ddcd0/standalone)

There is also a third session on graphic optimization (LOD, Draw Calls, etc to cover three phase when developing graphics for your game:

* Creating them with Blender
* Polishing your graphics
* Optimizing graphic delivery for smoother game play

comments.author: Dreamt_Up_Games
comments.body: I mean those are nice assets in the video and definitely usable for games but I would not say it’s AAA quality yet.

replies.author: Empty-Translator-310
replies.body: Can also tell it lacks an art director

replies.author: Aineisa
replies.body: Why does AI always over expose parts of the mesh

replies.author: Dreamt_Up_Games
replies.body: Also would love to know. Another thing I find impossible to get right with AI is making a UI for a game that doesn’t look like a generic website interface. Still buy asset packs for UI because AI is crap at it or I haven’t found a good workflow.

replies.author: swirllyman
replies.body: I've found the best way has been asking the ai to make actual sprites for the UI (usually nano banana). Then use these sprites as a template. Work much better than trying to one shot ui

replies.author: Dreamt_Up_Games
replies.body: Might give that a try thanks!

replies.author: EchoingAngel
replies.body: Codex can generate images for icons and elements on the fly. The backgrounds and containers are generally fine, though the icons need some effort to avoid sloppiness

comments.author: YKLKTMA
comments.body: This is not a AAA quality, it looks like cheap crap from an asset store

comments.author: meathelix1
comments.body: AAA.... haha I love the part where the Goat's neck just stretches.
